thesis: Charlie Munger argues that retail stock trading is akin to gambling because participants do not understand the companies and merely bet on price movements. He further contends that algorithms like Renaissance Technologies exploit human psychology by programming computers to follow short-term trends, effectively turning the market into a casino where the house always wins.
